items.title: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
items.description: Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.

items.title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?

items.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
items.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.
